basis: GA-regulated secreted alpha-amylase for starch mobilization; promoter-GUS first in scutellar epithelium then aleurone (Itoh et al. 1995 Plant Physiol), L1-epithelium in situ marker in embryos (Kamiya et al. 2003 Plant Cell Physiol), SCL1-enriched in Stereo-seq (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell). Also aleurone: adhering endosperm can give signal.

GA-induced glutelin-digesting cysteine endopeptidase REP-1 (reserve mobilization); ISH and Stereo-seq restricted to scutellar epithelium SCL1 (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell). Known mainly from aleurone (Shintani et al. 1997 Plant Cell Physiol), so adhering aleurone can give signal. Yao Fig 3A/B print it as Os10g0907600 (typo).

Cystatin (UniProt: Oryzacystatin X; paper symbol OsCYS9); ISH in the layer under the scutellar epithelium (SCL1-2) (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell). Label is a hypothesis: may be a histone-high state or SCL1/SCL2 mixed bins.
Class I metallothionein (stress-responsive family); SCL1-2 and SCL1 enriched in Stereo-seq only (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell).
Metallothionein (UniProt MT2C, synonym OsMT2b); SCL1-2 enriched in Stereo-seq only (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell).

PEBP germination repressor (ABA signalling; Song et al. 2020 Plant J); FISH in scutellar parenchyma SCL2 and KO germinates faster (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell). Stage-restricted: strong at 6 HAI, ~8-fold lower by 24 HAI.
Uncharacterized; SCL2 spatial marker (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell Fig S2C).
Uncharacterized; marker of BESCL2 (ends of scutellar parenchyma, absent at 6 HAI, heat/ROS genes at trajectory end), merged here into scutellar parenchyma (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell).
Uncharacterized; BESCL2 spatial marker, merged into scutellar parenchyma (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell).
Non-specific LTP1 (cuticle-associated family); COL1 coleoptile-epidermis ring in Stereo-seq (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell). Outer and inner epidermis not separated.
GPI-anchored LTP (cuticle-type); COL1 enriched in Stereo-seq (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell).
nsLTP (paper symbol 'LTP1'; Oryzabase LTP5); COL1 spatial marker (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell).

VLCFA-elongating KCS needed for the outermost cell layer (oni1 has aberrant epidermis); in situ in L1 of SAM and lateral organs (Ito et al. 2011 Plant J); COL1 coleoptile-epidermis enriched (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell). Shoot epidermis only.

HD-ZIP IV (GL2-type) outermost-cell-specific gene; in situ in embryo protoderm from shortly after fertilization (Ito et al. 2002 Plant J) and used as embryo L1 marker (Kamiya et al. 2003 Plant Cell Physiol; same group). Position-dependent: also outermost callus cells. Not in Yao 2024 marker panels.
Uncharacterized; ISH in coleoptile parenchyma (COL2) (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell Fig 2D). Coleoptile vascular bundles not separated from COL2.
nsLTP2; COL2 spatial marker (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell Fig S2C).
nsLTP1; ISH in the plumule region (SAM plus leaf primordia) (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell Fig 2D). Region marker, not one cell type; LTP family suggests protoderm.
nsLTP; PL spatial marker (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell Fig S2C). Region marker.
Cuticular wax aldehyde decarbonylase; PL enriched in Stereo-seq (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell). Probably leaf-primordium epidermis.

KNOX homeobox for SAM formation/maintenance; embryo in situ in SAM (not L1), weaker in epiblast and radicle (Sato et al. 1996 PNAS; Satoh et al. 1999 Development). Not in Yao 2024 panels; SAM is inside the PL region there.

ARGONAUTE (PINHEAD/ZLL homolog); in situ in presumptive vascular domains and developing vasculature of leaf primordia, antisense alters vascular pattern (Nishimura et al. 2002 Plant J); L3 marker in embryos (Kamiya et al. 2003 Plant Cell Physiol). Also adaxial primordium cells and weakly the SAM centre.

S-adenosylmethionine decarboxylase (polyamine synthesis); SCL3 scutellar-provascular marker that the paper says is expressed in all embryo vasculature (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell). Oryzabase symbol SAMDC4.

Low-temperature-germinability QTL; promoter-GUS in the epiblast covering the coleoptile (and aleurone over the embryo), linked to vacuolation/weakening of covering tissues (Fujino et al. 2008 PNAS); EP-CR enriched in Stereo-seq (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell).
Hybrid proline-rich protein; FISH in the merged epiblast + coleorhiza region (EP-CR), rising 6->48 HAI (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell Fig S2D). Organs not separated.
HyPRP; EP-CR spatial marker (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell Fig S2C). Dotplot labels it OsHyPRP17; text and Oryzabase give OsHyPRP20 for this ID.
LEA protein; RA (whole radicle) region marker in Stereo-seq (Yao et al. 2024 Dev Cell Fig 2E). Region, not one cell type; LEA genes fall with germination.

WUS-type homeobox; promoter-GUS and in situ in QC central cells, expressed in the embryonic radicle before root differentiation (Kamiya et al. 2003 Plant J). Same row as rice_root.tsv. Not resolved in Yao 2024.

SCARECROW ortholog; in situ in root endodermis/cortex-endodermis initials (Kamiya et al. 2003 Plant J) and L2 marker in embryos (Kamiya et al. 2003 Plant Cell Physiol). Also stomatal and ligule lineages in leaf primordia: in the plumule it does not mark endodermis. Same gene as rice_root.tsv.

G2/M cyclin; carried from rice_root.tsv (Zhang et al. 2021 Nat Commun). Expected in plumule/radicle meristems by 24-48 HAI; Yao 2024 did not separate a dividing state (PL GO chromatin terms; SCL1-2 histone-high).
DNA replication sliding clamp; carried from rice_root.tsv (Zhang et al. 2021 Nat Commun). Use to test whether Yao's histone-high SCL1-2 layer is an S-phase state.
